## Problem / motivation

Is your feature request related to a problem? Describe it clearly.

## Proposed solution

How should this feature work? Be as specific as possible.

## Alternatives considered

What other approaches did you consider? Why is your proposed solution better?

## Vexlyx context

- Does this fit Vexlyx's "hybrid panel" mission (modern apps + traditional hosting)?
- Does it affect the dashboard, API, Python system layer, or all three?
- Is there a comparable feature in cPanel, Plesk, Coolify, or Dokploy?

## Additional context

Mockups, links, prior art, or any other context.
